entities.summary: Last major division of classical japanese history (794 to 1185), named after the capital city of heian-kyō, or modern kyōto Part of history of Japan. (794 CE – 1185). Heian period is a historical period associated with Asia, spanning 794 CE to 1185. A moderately significant entity in the historical record.
